# In the Embrace of the Divine Mother

### Brother Chidananda • Self-Realization Fellowship

Loving greetings. Today we celebrate the infinite, tender compassion of God as the Divine Mother. God is not an angry judge; He is the most loving Parent who is always ready to receive us in Her arms of protection, no matter what mistakes we have made.

### The Mother's Unconditional Love

An earthly mother may fail, but the Eternal Mother never does. Through the study of our Guru’s lessons, we learn to talk to Her with child-like affection. When we pray with absolute sincerity, Her sweet presence wraps around us like a warm blanket.

### Overcoming Life's Tests with Her Grace

No test of life is too difficult when you are sitting in the lap of the Divine Mother. Refuse to carry your burdens alone. Give them all to Her, trusting in Her infinite wisdom to guide your steps.

### Practical Guidelines for Daily Life

* **Pray Simply:** Talk to the Divine Mother in your own simple, loving words: *"Receive me in Thy lap of peace."*
* **Sweet Chant:** Run a sweet, silent background chant of *"Jai Ma, Jai Ma"* during your daily tasks.
* **See Her in Women:** Cultivate a deep respect for all women, seeing them as expressions of the Mother's aspect.
* **Surrender Worries:** Place all your anxieties at Her feet before you sleep tonight.

May Her peace always find you. Jai Guru! Jai Ma.
